context: Asuka lectures on population and cities.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: demography lecture; population vocabulary (人口/世紀/中央/平均/どんどん) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: この世紀、都市の人口がどんどん増えました。
lines.en: This century, urban populations grew rapidly.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 人口は、中央に集まるんですか?
lines.en: Does the population gather in the center?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、中央の都市に、どんどん集中します。
lines.en: Yes, it rapidly concentrates in central cities.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 平均すると、増え方はどうですか?
lines.en: On average, how does it grow?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 平均では、毎年着実に増えています。
lines.en: On average, it grows steadily each year.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 地方の人口は、減っていますか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地方では、人口がどんどん減っています。
lines.en: In rural areas, population is rapidly declining.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 次の世紀の課題に、なりそうですね。
lines.en: It seems set to be a challenge for the next century.
lines.style: understanding adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
